projectContext.opportunityName: CPQ to Revenue Cloud Advanced Migration
projectContext.businessNeed: Northwind Instruments runs quoting on Salesforce CPQ across three acquired business units, each with its own product catalog and approval matrix. The CPQ estate is at end of support, quote cycle time has grown past ten days, and finance cannot close revenue without manual reconciliation against the ERP. Northwind has engaged Service Provider to migrate quote to cash onto Revenue Cloud Advanced on a single catalog and a single approval model.
projectContext.businessDriver: Salesforce CPQ reaches end of support, and the three acquired business units cannot be consolidated onto one catalog without re-platforming.

engagementType: CPQ to Revenue Cloud Advanced migration
engagementBoundary: This engagement migrates quote to cash for the three named business units onto Revenue Cloud Advanced. It does not re-implement Sales Cloud, and it does not change the ERP.
boundarySummary: Quote to cash for three business units on Revenue Cloud Advanced. Sales Cloud and the ERP stay as they are.
exclusions: Sales Cloud redesign, including opportunity, forecasting, and territory changes.

Contract lifecycle management (CLM) and document generation beyond the standard RCA quote template.
Usage-based billing and dynamic revenue orchestration.

scopeItems.name: Product catalog migration
scopeItems.description:
Consolidate the three business-unit catalogs into a single Revenue Cloud Advanced product catalog with a shared attribute model.

  • Extract and profile the active product set from the CPQ managed package.
  • Define the target attribute model and product classification.
  • Load, validate, and reconcile the migrated catalog against source.
scopeItems.assumptions: Northwind provides the active product list in a single extract per business unit. Up to 2,400 active products are migrated. Products beyond that volume are handled through a change order. Retired products are excluded from migration and remain in the legacy system for reference.

scopeItems.name: Pricing model configuration
scopeItems.description:
Configure list pricing, discount schedules, and price book structure for the consolidated catalog.

  • Up to 6 price books mapped from the legacy structure.
  • Volume and term discount schedules configured natively.
scopeItems.assumptions: No more than 6 price books are in scope. Pricing is list-plus-discount; no cost-plus or margin-floor pricing is configured. Approximately 35 legacy price rules are assessed, and rules that cannot be expressed natively are logged as a tier 3 item for change order.

scopeItems.name: Quoting and approvals
scopeItems.description:
Configure the quote object, quote line editor behavior, and the consolidated approval matrix across the three business units.

  • Single approval model replacing three legacy matrices.
  • Quote document template using the standard RCA output.
scopeItems.assumptions: Up to 40 approval rules across no more than 2 approval tiers. A third approval tier, if required, is a change order. One quote document template is in scope; additional templates are handled through change control.

scopeItems.name: Order management
scopeItems.description: Configure order creation from an accepted quote, including order products and the amendment path for in-flight orders.
scopeItems.assumptions: Orders are created from accepted quotes only. Manual order entry is out of scope. Amendments are limited to quantity and term changes; co-termination logic is not in scope.

scopeItems.name: ERP order interface
scopeItems.description:
Build the outbound interface that publishes accepted orders to the Northwind ERP.

  • Outbound order publication with retry and error queue.
  • Field mapping documented and co-signed in Design.
scopeItems.assumptions: One integration endpoint, outbound only, from Salesforce to the ERP. The ERP team owns and delivers the receiving endpoint. A second endpoint or any inbound interface is a change order. Middleware is provided by Northwind and is available from the start of Build.

scopeItems.name: Historical quote and order migration
scopeItems.description:
Migrate historical quote headers and accepted orders from the legacy CPQ estate into Revenue Cloud Advanced.

  • Two full dry runs before the production load.
  • Reconciliation report delivered against source counts.
scopeItems.assumptions: Approximately 18,000 quote headers covering 24 months of history are migrated. Quote line detail is migrated for accepted quotes only. History beyond 24 months, if required, is a change order. Northwind confirms the source system remains readable through cutover.
